method.source_fixture: Frozen NoAI/NoGravity invisible zombies, main hand torch equipped through /item replace and checked after every load
method.interval: Student t 95% of paired log ratios, df3 (combined8 df7); not independent frames
method.window_method: Own game PID selected in Hyprland Lua eval, floated/resized 1280x720; size and pose checked before and after. No global compositor changes. Initial tiling/unsupported legacy-command attempts rejected before timing.
method.isolation: Fresh game/home/XDG folders per launch, copied fixture save, read-only prepared resources; desktop applications/power settings unchanged. No tracing/builds/tests/concurrent game during primary FPS. Ambient particles retained.
method.diagnostic_caution: Single-pair ablations exploratory. Traces and CPU-clock profiles collected after FPS; instrumented executables separate from measured shipping candidate. Same-process modes0 original,1 candidate,2 borrowed/fullsort,3 owned/stack16,4 candidate+25us spin,5 candidate+50us spin. Padding/queue hints/caps are causal probes only; none shipped. Same-process raw arrays remain local; summaries and actual 16 light float-bit arrays exported.
method.diagnostic_raw_alignment: frame_ms[i] measures previous frame; align with cpu_ms[i-1]. stats raw fetched after bench adds subsequent frames; use exact bench prefix for analysis.
